addition.item: Added single-profile menu layouts with cards and tabs presentation modes.
Added directory teaser fields configuration to expose selected custom fields in directory cards.
Added hierarchical category labels in the public directory filter for clearer navigation across nested categories.

change.item: Directory category filtering now uses Joomla fancy-select rendering for a more consistent selection experience.
Router layout support now includes the cards and tabs profile variants.
Frontend profile and directory styling was refined for card, tab, and teaser-field presentation.

fix.item: Aligned directory category filter styling more closely with Joomla Choices and template CSS behavior.
Preserved visible hierarchy in nested directory category options instead of presenting them as a flat list.

note.item: This release focuses on profile presentation refinements and directory filtering usability improvements.

addition.item: Initial structured release of the Joomla!LABS Profiles package for Joomla 6.
Added standalone profile management for person and legal entity records.
Added administrator profile management with list, filters, edit form, and modal selectors.
Added public directory and profile detail views with SEF routing and nested category path support.
Added native Joomla custom fields, privacy, action log, and versioning integration.

change.item: Configured package-based distribution with component and plugin constituents built through the Ant pipeline.
Aligned custom field frontend display mapping with the profile UI rendering strategy.

note.item: Requires Joomla 6.0.0 or higher, PHP 8.1 or higher, and MySQL 8 or MariaDB 10.5+.
